Class TurnOrderPayload

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.shared.payload.servertoclient.game.TurnOrderPayload
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TurnOrderPayload extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the sequence/turn order of players for a game round.

This includes the round number, active round phase, the nickname of the player whose turn is active, and the full ordered list of player nicknames.
